bull.point: Revenue growth is accelerating significantly, reaching 14% year-on-year in the latest quarter.
bull.evidence: Sep 2026 revenue of ₹18,226 Cr represents 14.0% YoY growth compared to 0.0% in Jun 2025.

bull.point: The company maintains a robust financial profile with high returns and negligible debt levels.
bull.evidence: Debt/Equity ratio is 0.03, ROE is 31.0%, and ROCE stands at 28.4%.

bull.point: Management is aggressively investing in premium segments to drive future strategic transformation.
bull.evidence: Committed Rs. 2,000 crores of capex investments in premium formats of Beauty and Home Care.

bear.point: Operating profit margins are under pressure, declining to the lower end of management's guided range.
bear.evidence: Latest-quarter margin fell to 22% in Sep 2026 from 24% in the previous year.

bear.point: Cash flow efficiency has deteriorated sharply, with operating cash falling well below reported profits.
bear.evidence: CFO to PAT percentage dropped to 73.04% in Mar 2026 from 111.39% in Mar 2025.

bear.point: Long-term capital efficiency has weakened significantly over the past five years.
bear.evidence: ROCE has declined to 28% from 39% five years ago.

watch_next: Whether EBITDA margins stay within the 22% to 24% guided range.
Sustainability of double-digit revenue growth amid inflation and pricing concerns.
Recovery in rural demand and volume growth momentum.
